submittedInput.content: I applied for a library assistant job through a site I already use. The reply offers an interview at the library during office hours and asks me to bring my CV. It asks for no fee, password, code or software installation.

body.title: Check through a trusted route
body.nextStep: Use the official app or a contact route you already know to confirm the request.
body.reason: As described, “offers an interview at the library during office hours”; “asks me to bring my CV”. This ordinary arrangement states no payment, account-access or remote-control demand; the contact’s identity is not verified.
body.uncertainty: This covers the details supplied. A later request may need a new check.
